user.title: Connect Navidrome
user.description: Credentials for the Navidrome Subsonic API.

abort.already_configured: This Navidrome account is already configured.

init.title: Tonies and playlists

tonie.title: {name}
tonie.description: Navidrome playlist for this Creative Tonie. “(none)” stops syncing (chapters stay on the Tonie).

abort.no_toniebox: No Creative Tonies found. Is the Toniebox integration set up and loaded?

options.append: Playlist adds to foreign chapters (they stay at the start)

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Syncs the Navidrome playlist to the Creative Tonie. Without a target: all Tonies with a playlist.

restore_deleted.name: Restore deleted
restore_deleted.description: Upload songs again whose chapter was deleted in the Tonie app.

confirm_removals.name: Confirm removals
confirm_removals.description: Run even if the playlist is empty or more than half (and more than 3) of the chapters would be removed.

adopt.name: Adopt chapters as playlist
adopt.description: Matches the existing chapters of a Creative Tonie to Navidrome songs. Without “Apply” only a report; with “Apply” a playlist is created and assigned to the Tonie (nothing is changed on the Tonie).

entity_id.name: Creative Tonie
entity_id.description: Media player of the Creative Tonie (Toniebox integration).

config_entry_id.name: Navidrome account
config_entry_id.description: Tonie Sync entry to use. Only needed if several are set up.

playlist_name.name: Playlist name
playlist_name.description: Default: “Tonie” followed by the Tonie name, for example “Tonie Bedtime”.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Create the playlist and adopt the mapping. Without: report only.

search_songs.name: Search songs
search_songs.description: Searches songs in Navidrome and returns them (ID, artist, title, album, duration).

config_entry_id.name: Navidrome account
config_entry_id.description: Tonie Sync entry to use. Only needed if several are set up.

playlist_edit.name: Edit Tonie playlist
playlist_edit.description: Adds songs to or removes songs from the Navidrome playlist of a Tonie. The Tonie itself only changes with the next sync.

entity_id.name: Tonie
entity_id.description: A Tonie Sync entity of the Tonie.

remove_song_ids.name: Remove songs
remove_song_ids.description: Navidrome song IDs to remove from the playlist.

invalid_target.message: {entity} does not belong to Tonie Sync.

not_set_up.message: Tonie Sync is not set up.

invalid_entry.message: This config entry does not belong to a loaded Tonie Sync setup.

entry_mismatch.message: The entity belongs to a different Tonie Sync entry than the one given.

multiple_entries.message: Several Tonie Sync entries are set up; choose one with config_entry_id.
